brand_casing: dotBANG — dot lowercase, BANG uppercase. .! in code and as the mark.
domain_status: TBD — awaiting Tyler's pick. Candidates checked 2026-11-03 via RDAP: dotbang.com taken/parked for sale (HugeDomains since 2014); dotbang.ai, dotbang.labs, dotbang.io not-registered. Do not register, do not publish a canonical URL, do not add a sitemap domain until Tyler picks.
positioning: Consulting front door: AI systems built on a company's own data. Five screens, one daily refresh, a brief the decision-maker can read in twenty minutes.
concept: The audience is the business; the knowledge stays free; merch and USB starter kits are downstream. The paid work is AI systems for companies with data they cannot use.

contact.note: No form, no displayed email — the privacy rule forbids personal data in public files.

design_system.palette_ratio: field 70-80%, ink 10-15%, accent 4-14%, signal 0-1%; checked on rendered pixels with the pack's audit_palette.py. One pink element per surface (P-01: available-for-work status square).
design_system.accent_usage: Structural only: filled accent plate with black type (8.66:1), 4px accent rules, filled primary action with black type. White type on the accent is banned (2.43:1).
design_system.rules: Four values, no fifth colour. No radius, no blur, no gradient. Hairlines are 1px at 10-12% ink.

performance_budget.measured_on: Lighthouse 12.8.2, throttled mobile profile, gzip-serving local host
performance_budget.render_blocking: none — CSS inlined at commit time by scripts/inline_css.py
performance_budget.note: LCP 1.20s is the declared ceiling, met not beaten; the remaining cost is the throttled font fetch.

entity.status: Utah LLC not yet filed. Footer reads 'Utah, United States' until the certificate exists, then flips to dotBANG LLC.

privacy_rule: No personal data, real IPs, hostnames, emails, or internal URLs in any public file.
